text:
maria: FYI support case #4021 — multiple customers started seeing 401s + repeated retries after last night's SDK regen CI. Repro steps below, looks like auth header format changed in TS client.

ben: ugh. any rollback signal from CI? which SDKs regenerated?

maria: regen job ran @ 2026-03-16 02:13 UTC (ci#openapi-regen/482). Affected: ts-client v1.12.0 (auto), python-client v0.9.4 (minor changes). go client untouched.

kai: I pulled the OpenAPI diff — auth header schema didn't change, but codegen templates updated how `Authorization` header is built for bearer tokens. Old behavior: "Bearer\u00A0${token}" (no nbsp). New code added a small normalize step that sometimes returns empty string for token when env var is undefined.

sam: customers report this sequence: 1) app starts fine, 2) first few requests OK, 3) after token refresh, subsequent requests get 401 with `invalid_token` and SDKs retry 429-style causing billing spikes.

lisa: can you paste the minimal repro? need to triage support impact and convo with billing ops.

maria: repro (TS):
```ts
import RedwoodClient from '@redwood/sdk'
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
await c.completions.create({ model: 'rwd-small', input: 'hi' })
// then force token refresh: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY = ''
await c.completions.create({ model: 'rwd-small', input: 'again' })
```
Observed: second call returns 401, SDK retries twice then surfaces error.

ben: can you capture headers from failing call? stack and curl fallback pls.

maria: failing headers show `authorization: Bearer ` (trailing space, no token). Support case includes raw logs. Billing noticed token-less retries -> counting as billable tokens.

kai: Found generator template change: `auth.ts` line 87 now does `return \`Bearer ${normalizeToken(token)}\`` where `normalizeToken('') -> ' '` if token undefined. Before it returned `Bearer` (no space) which downstream infra ignored. Small diff but big impact.

support-bot: pinging @billing-ops: potential overcharge window 02:15-02:40 UTC.

sam: we should patch codegen template to early-fail if token empty and avoid retry. Also patch regen CI to run a smoke auth test on each SDK artifact.

lisa: agree. we also need a changelog blurb and postmortem note; customers need credits if billed. I'll draft once we have root cause.

maria: quick mitigation: add runtime guard in TS client to throw `MissingApiKeyError` if token falsy before sending. I'll open PR.

ben: ETA on PR? make it a hotfix to 1.12.1 and add a soft rollback for auto-regen to previous template if we detect auth-related tests failing.

maria: creating PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ts-sdk/pull/724 (wip) — includes unit + integration smoke that simulates token rotation.

kai: will add a CI job to diff generated auth code against a golden snippet; fail regen if mismatch. Also flagger to require explicit opt-in for template changes that affect headers.

deploy-bot: regen-ci job 482 logs: summary: templates changed (auth.ts), tests passed (unit) but integration auth smoke was missing -> merge happened.

sam: long-term we need cross-sdk integration tests that run against a staging auth endpoint and also ensure retry logic doesn't amplify auth failures.

lisa: I'll coordinate support comms and billing credits. @ben can you estimate impacted accounts list from support export?

ben: yes — pulling support case exports now, will share CSV in #support.

maria: thanks all. follow-ups:
- PR 724 hotfix (maria)
- regen CI smoke + golden auth check (kai)
- billing impact CSV + credits plan (ben & lisa)
- postmortem draft (lisa)

maria: closing loop: once PR is merged I'll trigger regen rollback and bump ts-client to v1.12.1. :thumbsup:
